querycraft.title: Querycraft: Text-2-SQL
querycraft.copy: A schema-grounded text-to-SQL workbench built with Python, Flask, SQLite, SQLGlot, and JavaScript. Explore a schema, generate and edit SQL, approve read-only execution, and export results to CSV.
querycraft.detail: Validation includes read-only SQL checks, query deadlines, and row limits. Résumé-reported verification: 92 AI-automated tests and browser regression checks.
querycraft.label: querycraft / workbench

jev.title: Jev News-Signal Classifier
jev.copy: A Python CLI and importable classifier using TypeSafe’s Jev API to assess positive or negative news implications for a named subject.
jev.detail: Reports class probabilities, directional relevance, and an uncertainty flag. A binary label is not a trading recommendation; live inference quality has not been verified.

financial.title: Financial Data Analytics
financial.copy: An interactive Streamlit dashboard and Python notebook analyzing Federal Reserve G.19 consumer credit: revolving and nonrevolving balances, growth, composition, volatility, and recession-era behavior.
financial.detail: The analysis covers 1968 onward, when the revolving/nonrevolving split begins. G.19 measures balances, not delinquency. These are genuine chart exports committed with the project notebook.

credit.title: Credit Risk Charge-Off Prediction Model
credit.copy: An XGBoost credit-risk model trained on 2.3M+ Lending Club loans, with fuzzy-augmentation reject inference incorporating 27M+ declined applications to address accept-only sample bias.
credit.detail: Tuned with stratified 5-fold cross-validation. Résumé-reported results: 0.709 AUC and 0.303 KS, with segment analysis across grade, debt-to-income, and FICO bands.
credit.label: credit risk / model analysis
credit.mediaNote: Model report or demo recording pending.

fraud.title: Fraud Transaction Detection
fraud.copy: A Wells Fargo transaction-classification project using 1M rows, categorical one-hot encoding, and feature engineering. The résumé lists Tableau Prep, Python, H2O, and XGBoost.
fraud.detail: XGBoost hyperparameters were tuned using grid and randomized search with cross-validation. Résumé-reported accuracy: 93%.
fraud.label: fraud detection / model analysis

alzheimers.title: Alzheimer’s Prediction
alzheimers.copy: A TensorFlow 2D convolutional neural network for brain-MRI classification. Images were resized to 128 × 128 pixels with an 80:10:10 training, validation, and test split.
alzheimers.detail: Used dropout regularization to address overfitting. Résumé-reported test-set accuracy: 92%. This is a learning project, not a clinically validated diagnostic tool.
alzheimers.label: alzheimer’s prediction / deep learning
